name: Dealing With A Liar
overview: Scripture clearly condemns lying and deceit as detestable to the Lord, emphasizing that those who practice falsehood cannot dwell in His presence or be established (Psalms 101:7; Proverbs 12:19). God commands His people not to bear false witness against their neighbors (Exodus 20:16), highlighting the importance of truthfulness as a reflection of His character. The Proverbs affirm that lying lips are an abomination to the Lord, while those who speak truth bring Him delight (Proverbs 12:22), and faithful witnesses are distinguished by their refusal to lie (Proverbs 14:5). Thus, dealing with a liar requires recognizing the spiritual seriousness of falsehood and upholding truth as a divine mandate.
